 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



, SECTION 1.     Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

 Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial

 District syi-nbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-J in an area bound by j



 The public alley next north of and parallel to West Cermak Avenue; South Sawyer
 Avenue; West Cermak Avenue; And a line 145.0 feet west of and parallel to South

 Sawyer Avenue



 to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District.

 SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property: 3232-46 West Cermak Road
          Tvpe-1 ZONING MAP AiVlKNDMKNT: NARRATIVE & IM^ANS

                      ADDRESS - 3232 to 3246 W. Cermak Rd.

The applicant seeks to rezone this property as a Transit-Served Location to construct a 5-
story mixed-use building with a ground floor commercial space, 59 residential units and
60 bicycle parking stalls.


FAR                   4.0*
Building Area         72,467 Square Feet
Density (MLA)         307 Square Feet
Lot Area              18,125 Square Feet
Building Height       79 Feet 9 Inches
Front Setback         0 Feet 0 Inches
Rear Setback          0 Feet 0 Inches**
East Side Setback     0 Feet 0 Inches
West Side Setback     8 Feet 10 Inches
Parking               3 Parking Stalls
                      60 Bike Parking Spaces **
Loading Spaces        0 Loading Spaces ***

*The applicant will seek necessary relief to establish the property as a transit-served
location and to provide 100% of the required affordable units on-site in order to be
eligible for the height enhancement provided in 17-3-0408B(2), the MLA reduction
provided in 17-3-0402B, the increased and additional FAR provisions set forth in 17-3-
0403-B and C and the parking requirement reductions provided for in both the residential
and commercial uses under 17-I00102-B(1) and (2) and Sections 17-13-0905-F(la-e),
Parking Reduction for Transit Served Location.

**The applicant will seek the necessary relief for rear yard residential set back
requirements from 30.0' to 0.0' to match the existing building which will remain.

***The applicant will seek the necessary relief to waive the required loading dock
requirement from 1 to 0.
